rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TNW159R

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Additional Details: Hi, we're still having the recurring issue with the water heater tripping the breaker. It hasn't stopped even after the new water heater was installed, so we'd like to request a certified electrician come look at it to figure out the actual cause.
Some possibilities worth checking: an incorrect breaker size for the unit, a loose wire connection, a damaged or grounded heating element, or a faulty breaker itself.
Also, when we first moved in back in 2023, the maintenance person who fixed our lights mentioned that the wiring in the unit needed to be looked at. Given that history, this breaker issue may be related — it would be good for the electrician to check the unit's wiring more broadly while they're at it.
Please let us know when someone can come take a look.
Thank you.

Troubleshooting Steps: 
- Did not try to reset breaker
Permission to Enter: Yes

D - Maintenance - T1L33WF

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TC7DXUJ

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TDWHVBL

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

* Check for broken or cracked glass

* Verify window locks operate properly

* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
Shower Needs Updating - T5ZI98U

Resident said: Shower needs updating
Additional Details: Hello,

I am writing to request an accessibility modification for Ms. Ivy's bathroom due to significant safety concerns.

Ms. Ivy is 94 years old, and her current bathtub/shower setup has become increasingly difficult and unsafe for her to use. Stepping over the tub wall presents a serious fall risk, and she currently relies on a transfer bench for bathing. Because the bathroom is very small, the transfer bench makes it difficult to move around safely, creating additional hazards during transfers and increasing the risk of injury.

A walk-in shower would provide a much safer bathing environment by eliminating the need to step over the tub wall, which is one of the primary safety concerns. Walk-in showers are recommended when stepping over a tub wall is unsafe, when a client uses a shower chair or wheelchair, when there is a high fall risk during bathing, or when fear of falling causes someone to avoid bathing altogether. 

Given Ms. Ivy's advanced age and mobility limitations, an accessible bathroom would help her bathe safely, reduce her risk of falls, and allow her to maintain her independence. Without these modifications, she remains at increased risk for a serious injury that could result in hospitalization or loss of independence.

We respectfully request that the property consider replacing the existing tub with a walk-in shower or another ADA-accessible shower solution as a reasonable accessibility modification.

Thank you for your time and consideration. We appreciate your attention to this important safety issue and look forward to working together on a solution that will help Ms. Ivy remain safe in her home.

Sincerely,

Brandi Miller
EZ Health Guide

Permission to Enter: Yes

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting

* Verify that refrigerator is cooling

* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T5E531W

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - T6M3DXCB

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TQRKMUI

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TEXY83LB

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T42YZ14

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TH9DD4E

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TCFFNK1

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TA2CJ0HB

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TYP8QZC

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - THV5WDCB

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TVZ8NUR

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TMIVE25

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T5L2XV1

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - TKZDG34

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing
